authorial_core.source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 주제에 어울리는 랜덤한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
authorial_core.interpreted_intent: The prior human topic names palace/court material; the present user requests a fitting random photographic test concept and use of the supplied image. Independently choose a fictional European court in a late-eighteenth-century visual idiom. The authorial scene is admission through an audience-room threshold: a paused step, an usher opening a route and waiting courtiers make access legible without relying on a crown. Compare a frontal enthroned portrait with this threshold encounter; choose the encounter because social spacing and reciprocal attention make court life readable and give the reference-based woman an inhabited moment. At saved creativity 1 this stays a restrained court scene. Sensual 1 is a subtle supporting attraction in her attentive presence, silk and face light; fetish 0 and surreal 0 introduce no added treatment. Face/hair reference scope establishes visible appearance only, not identity, real age, personality or biography. All detailed era, costume, access choreography and camera treatment are replaceable agent staging.
authorial_core.subject: A woman based on the visible face and hair of the supplied portrait, with an usher and waiting courtiers as authorial supporting actors.
authorial_core.setting: A fictional late-eighteenth-century European palace antechamber adjoining an audience room.
authorial_core.event: Participation in palace court life, realized as a woman being admitted through an audience-room doorway.
visual_priorities: The reference-based woman remains the portrait center while her paused step and attentive face connect to the usher.
The open route, usher and waiting courtiers read together as controlled palace access.
Cool blue silk and face light separate the woman from the warmer inner chamber.
authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: Photograph a woman taking part in palace court life in a fictional late-eighteenth-century European palace court. Use the supplied portrait as the reference for her visible face and hair: the short dark bob, separated wispy fringe, dark eyes and softly rounded facial contours remain recognizable. Her clothing and the scene are newly staged. She has reached the doorway of an inner audience room after waiting in an antechamber; an usher has just opened one leaf of the tall gilded double door, making a narrow passage for her while the other courtiers remain outside. She stands left of the open doorway, her body angled toward the passage but her face still visible in a gentle three-quarter view. Her front foot rests just before the brass threshold and her weight remains on the rear foot. Her left hand holds a closed ivory-colored folding fan at waist height; her right hand falls naturally beside the blue silk skirt. The usher stands to the right of the passage, his left hand around the door handle and his right palm extended low toward the empty route through the door. They look toward each other. Her slightly parted lips and attentive gaze carry a private breath of anticipation within a public ceremony. A pale blue silk court gown has a fitted square-neck bodice, elbow-length lace cuffs and a broad structured skirt whose folds catch the window light. The usher wears an embroidered dark coat and knee breeches. Two waiting courtiers in restrained silk court dress remain several paces back, their bodies turned toward the same doorway. The antechamber has pale paneled walls, gilt pilasters and a parquet floor; beyond the open leaf, a deeper red-walled room and a raised empty chair are visible in alignment. Compose a full-length vertical photograph, slightly off the passage axis, with her face and the usher's open palm clear and the threshold entirely visible. Cool afternoon window light shapes her face and the blue silk against the warmer inner room. Use realistic skin texture, tactile silk, controlled gilded highlights and enough depth of field for the social spacing and doorway to read together. The visual center is the interval between her paused step and the usher's permission, with her quiet presence carrying the portrait's subtle attraction.
